items.title: Radisson’s First Net Zero Hotel in Africa Signals Shift From Leased to Managed Properties
items.summary: Radisson’s net zero push is moving from hotels it leases to hotels it manages. In South Africa, the hardest part wasn’t the building investments but buying the necessary renewable power.

items.title: UAE Travelers Hesitate After Houthi Attacks But Aren’t Canceling
items.summary: Travelers in the region are adapting to conflict rather than retreating from it, with flexible fares in demand and, for some, shorter booking windows.

items.title: The Rise of One-Person Travel Businesses

items.title: Riyadh Air Is Busing Passengers 270 Miles to Avoid Houthi Strikes
